notes:
Status: Closed-lost to OpenAI direct API. POC showed Redwood performance and potential cost savings on longer sessions, but engineering and procurement favored OpenAI for its off-the-shelf SDK, existing vendor relationships, and perceived lower integration friction.

Key quotes: 'We need the path of least resistance — their SDK + brand is reassuring.' / 'Procurement wants fewer vendors on the PO list.'

Security: Aurora required SOC2, SSO and KMS — Redwood met requirements technically, provided docs (see drive links), but procurement timeline was the gating factor.

Commercial: Redwood pricing was competitive; estimated ARR 50k-150k. Procurement cited internal policy to standardize on a single large provider when possible to reduce legal cycles.

Internal notes and next steps: capture lessons learned - emphasize quick-start SDKs and partnership comps in future deals; target re-engage window Q3 2026 after product refresh and offer a free Dedicated trial or migration credits.
